allowed_flow_variations: The harness may enable retiming or physical optimization. The candidate's retained synthesis script is authoritative for its actual settings.
authority: Harness evidence is fixed. Proposed architectural goals cannot redefine it.

build_spec.authority: Complete resolved typed build contract. Defined behavior is mandatory; explicitly unspecified cases remain unspecified. Frozen implementation identities do not turn incidental values in unspecified cases into requirements.

modules.behavior: Two-stage elastic unsigned dot-product pipeline. Compute a0*b0+a1*b1+a2*b2+a3*b3 exactly, output 0..260100. All eight operands are unsigned 8-bit, products16-bit, pair sums17-bit and final sum18-bit, preserve carries. Exactly two slots: stage1 holds two partial sums and valid v1; stage2 holds result and valid v2. out_valid=v2, stage2_ready=!v2||out_ready, in_ready=!v1||stage2_ready. Handshakes sample before rising-edge updates. On a rising edge, if stage2_ready update v2 from old v1 and when old v1 true capture sum of old partials. If in_ready update v1 from in_valid and when in_valid true capture current tuple's partials. Never bypass stage1 to output. Input captured at edge k is first output-valid after edge k+1 if stage2 can advance; earliest retirement at edge k+2 (minimum accepted-transfer age2). Bubbles and output stalls can delay transfers. Sustain one accepted input and output per edge after filling; support full simultaneous retire/advance/replace. Capacity2, not combinational empty bypass. Output-valid is stage2 occupancy, NOT total nonempty. On rising-edge synchronous active-high rst clear both valid slots, abort outstanding transactions, and override all transfers. Reset does not gate valid/ready combinationally or clear state between edges; an entirely off-edge reset pulse has no effect. Keep valid and defined output payload stable while stalled until transfer or synchronous reset. Invalid out_data is unspecified. Inputs are captured only on input handshake; producer holds in_valid and ALL eight operands stable while blocked, except reset abort. For the Python scoreboard oracle ONLY, one non-reset step maps an accepted eight-operand tuple directly to eventual out_data; no valid bits, occupancy, pipeline queue, scheduling or delay in oracle. init represents reset; supplied rst returns out_data=0. RTL must implement all temporal behavior above; independent TB verifies exact availability, capacity, throughput and resets.
modules.name: elastic_dot4_core

declared_latency.meaning: A source annotation declares numeric latency only when present. This known/cycles pair is authoritative for the current top module's annotation requirement. Only known=true requires a matching numeric top annotation. Child typed-module latency does not invent a top annotation for arbitrary aggregate wrappers. When known=false, absence of a top annotation is not a failed or unverifiable criterion. Unannotated numeric latency is UNKNOWN, not zero. Preserve the source's exact observable cycles and registered behavior. Annotation presence or absence alone is not independent proof of behavioral correctness; use the fixed source contract, all defined typed latency/minimum transfer age and deterministic verification, without inventing a numeric requirement.

edit_scope.reason: The supplied testbench instantiates the top elastic_dot4 and is the trusted integration authority, so every generated child module and the mechanical top form one editable unit verified through the top. Per-child generated oracles and testbenches verified the baseline children only and are not evidence for changed children.

implementation.meaning: Chip-top implementation: the top is the whole FPGA design. Every port bit gets an I/O buffer on a package pin, and data ports have zero input and output delay to clk, so the routed WNS and WHS include pad delay. Utilization includes the I/O buffers.

metric_provenance: Structured metrics are parsed from retained reports; routed utilization/timing reports take precedence when present. The manifest identifies complete files by hash. Header excerpts are bounded previews, not complete reports or an independent metric source.
objective_policy: First establish timing feasibility. A verified timing-feasible candidate may replace a known timing-infeasible previous best even with higher area or power; classify this as timing_recovery, not objective savings. While the previous best is timing-infeasible, a verified still-infeasible candidate with strictly better setup WNS and hold not worse beyond a small tolerance may replace it as timing_progress, which is not closure; a feasible candidate always outranks it. Once both are timing-feasible, require strict improvement of the chosen objective; for maximize_freq that is register-to-register setup slack (reg2reg_wns_ns) when both designs report it, otherwise full setup WNS for both, while feasibility stays on full WNS and WHS. minimize_luts compares (lut_used, ff_used) and minimize_ffs compares (ff_used, lut_used) lexicographically: an equal primary metric with a strictly lower secondary is an objective improvement, a higher primary never is, and a secondary missing from either design gives no tie-break. Unknown or contradictory incumbent timing evidence cannot establish recovery. A completed experiment may find no improvement. Do not invent mandatory savings, slack margins, tool versions, timing corners, new tests, thresholds, code-style quotas or external environment requirements.
